reviewer: Codex: authored outline and actual synthetic native output review
review_scope: Reviewed five authored narratives, factual inputs and ten native synthetic demo/practice regressions. Italian lesson top and practice sections inspected in the browser. Review records in the regression are simulated, not learner decisions. Direct component execution and rendering do not establish installed enabled-plugin, native voice, paired-window or learner acceptance. No professional, legal or tax qualification is claimed. Native course-chat runtime review: unchanged authored lesson text, inputs, expectations and editorial judgments; new UI handoff validated by 39 focused tests. Host-native acceptance remains separate.

editorial.purpose_and_first_use: The complete first synthetic use proceeds from fictional mandate and documents to proposal, explicit review, changed evidence and dossier inspection; it prepares a future supervised pilot without authorizing a real mandate.
editorial.inputs_and_request: Ten JSON source files supply two independent fictional cases and changed liabilities. They contain facts and explicit unknowns, no preapproved records, conclusions or exported dossier. The natural request states the synthetic scope and withholds valuation until the blocked-capital checkpoint.
editorial.execution_and_checkpoints: The current installed specialist owns execution. The worker uses the documented private synthetic-folder exception, not Studio Archive. Checkpoints inspect branch blockers and capital/vote/profit rights before decisions and selective staleness after evidence replacement. A digest binds only an explicitly expressed decision.
editorial.deliverable_and_next_action: Versioned Markdown/JSON dossier, manifest and history make evidence, exact amounts, independent rights, missing receipts/tax bases and earlier decisions inspectable. A local generic disclosure report is required. The lesson explains that arithmetic and exports do not approve an operation.
editorial.practice_and_repeat: Practice uses separate fresh files with assets 640000 and liabilities 270000, then changes liabilities to 305000. It preserves the demonstration, corrects dependent arithmetic/findings and requests a new review while independent collection remains current. Repeat is synthetic-only.
editorial.language_and_pacing: The complete it outline preserves the same case, numbers, rights and boundaries. Source fields and native dossier remain Italian, explained in the selected language. Five to eight minutes is only explanation and brief-attempt pacing; full review and practice can extend it, with no measured learner duration.

History retains three simulated decisions and old exports. Local report states no model/network invocation by the regression and does not attest learner exposure. Exact values match the lesson review criteria.
